operation_files.result_contract: - result: compact summaries normally. Successful `search_control` calls and `colony_control` reads for `domain=bio bioDomain=farming action=seed_catalog|list_planting` or `domain=management kind=research action=list` retain the complete child result, including existing route aliases. Other colony reads/writes stay compact by default. Search `detail=brief|compact|full` keeps its native meaning. Boolean `detail=false` suppresses result output; `detail=true` also echoes arguments and retains full results/errors. Narrow results with `query`/`limit`; counts and truncation remain as reported by the child.
operation_files.single_command_error: This operation replacement contains {0} executable commands; at most {1} is allowed. No command in this replacement was executed.
operation_files.single_command_guidance: Preview one command at a time, execute it with confirmation, then read the result again. A later execution failure may leave earlier changes; no automatic rollback is performed.
operation_files.single_command_safety: - safety: each operation replacement accepts at most one executable command. Preview, confirm execution, then read the result again. Earlier successful replacements can remain after a later execution failure; no automatic rollback is performed.
